instruments.title: Add Luottolaitoslaki, 610/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitostoiminnasta (610/2014), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Credit Institutions

payload.implementsNote: CRD, Directive 2013/36/EU as amended (including Directives (EU) 2019/878 and (EU) 2024/1619); Payment Accounts Directive 2014/92/EU; BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU (recovery planning)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain comprehensive governance arrangements and reliable internal control

titles.en: Maintain comprehensive governance arrangements and reliable internal control

summaries.en: A credit institution must have governance arrangements that are comprehensive and proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of its business, so that it is run effectively and prudently and its board can oversee management. The board approves the risk strategy and ensures reliable internal control over financial reporting, compliance and disclosure; duties are segregated to avoid conflicts of interest, and the board must regularly assess the effectiveness of the arrangements. The board chair may not also be the chief executive without FIN-FSA's permission, and from 1 October 2026 not at all.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure board members and management are reliable and competent

titles.en: Ensure board members and management are reliable and competent

summaries.en: Board members and executive management of a credit institution must be reliable persons of good repute, not bankrupt, under a business ban or of restricted legal capacity, and must have the knowledge and experience of the business, its risks and management that their role requires. Changes in management must be notified to FIN-FSA without delay. From 1 October 2026 amended rules extend the requirements to key function holders and require the institution to verify them before appointment and throughout the term.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate an independent internal channel for reporting suspected breaches

titles.en: Operate an independent internal channel for reporting suspected breaches

summaries.en: A credit institution must have procedures through which its employees can report suspected breaches of financial market rules internally through an independent channel, with proper handling of reports, protection of the reporter and protection of the personal data involved. Information on reports is kept and deleted after five years unless still needed for an investigation, proceedings or the protection of rights, with the need reviewed at least every three years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Align remuneration systems with strategy, long-term interests and sound risk management

titles.en: Align remuneration systems with strategy, long-term interests and sound risk management

summaries.en: A credit institution's remuneration systems must be consistent with the business strategy, objectives, values and long-term interests of the institution and its consolidation group, must support sound and effective risk management and must not encourage risk-taking beyond the risk level set on the basis of its risk-bearing capacity. From 1 October 2026 they must also take account of the institution's risk appetite for ESG risks and must not treat staff unequally on the basis of gender.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain a recovery plan for a significant deterioration of the financial position

titles.en: Maintain a recovery plan for a significant deterioration of the financial position

summaries.en: A credit institution that is not part of a group under consolidated supervision must have a recovery plan for keeping its business going if its financial position deteriorates significantly, for example when it risks breaching its capital or liquidity requirements or the internal indicators set in the plan. A subsidiary credit institution of a group parent is generally covered by the group recovery plan instead.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess and maintain adequate internal capital at all times

titles.en: Assess and maintain adequate internal capital at all times

summaries.en: A credit institution must at all times hold enough own funds to cover the risks it faces and must not take risks that materially endanger its solvency or liquidity. It must have sound, comprehensive and effective strategies and procedures to assess and maintain the amount, quality and distribution of internal capital; from 1 October 2026 ESG risks over the short, medium and long term must be covered as well.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain documented risk management and internal control systems

titles.en: Maintain documented risk management and internal control systems

summaries.en: A credit institution must have effective, reliable and documented governance arrangements for identifying, managing, limiting, monitoring and reporting its current and future risks. These include a clear organisational structure with well-defined lines of responsibility, effective risk reporting processes, and sound internal control, administrative and accounting procedures, proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt board-approved plans and systems for managing ESG risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitostoiminnasta (610/2014), 9 luku 3 a § ja 17 a §

titles.en: Adopt board-approved plans and systems for managing ESG risks

summaries.en: From 1 October 2026 the board of a credit institution must approve one or more plans with quantitative targets and processes to monitor and address financial risks arising from environmental, social and governance factors in the short, medium and long term, including transition risks towards climate neutrality. The institution must have robust strategies, policies, processes and systems to identify, measure, manage and monitor ESG risks, proportionate to its business model.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Outsource significant functions only under a written agreement that preserves control

titles.en: Outsource significant functions only under a written agreement that preserves control

summaries.en: A credit institution may use agents or outsource functions significant to its business only if this does not impair its risk management, internal control or the running of its business, and it must conclude a written agreement stating the content and duration of the engagement. It must ensure that it continuously receives from the service provider the information needed for supervision, risk management and internal control and may pass it on to FIN-FSA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Follow good banking practice and market fairly

titles.en: Follow good banking practice and market fairly

summaries.en: A credit institution must comply with good banking practice. In marketing it must give customers all information that may matter for their decisions and must not give untrue or misleading information or use practices that are inappropriate or contrary to good practice; marketing that omits information needed for the customer's financial security is always inappropriate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer basic banking services and a basic payment account without discrimination

titles.en: Offer basic banking services and a basic payment account without discrimination

summaries.en: A deposit bank that offers payment accounts, payment services and electronic identification services must offer them equally and without discrimination to persons legally resident in the EEA. A deposit bank that provides payment services must offer natural persons a euro-denominated basic payment account with the related payment services and electronic identification, in line with 6 a and 6 b §.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Respect the maximum loan-to-collateral ratio for housing loans

titles.en: Respect the maximum loan-to-collateral ratio for housing loans

summaries.en: A credit institution may grant a consumer credit secured on a home for buying or renovating a dwelling only up to 90 percent of the fair value of the collateral at the time of granting, or 95 percent for a first home; a personal guarantee does not count as collateral. FIN-FSA may lower these caps by up to 10 percentage points to curb financial stability risks, or raise the cap for other than first homes by up to 5 points in a housing market downturn.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base consumer lending on sound written criteria and a reliable risk rating system

titles.en: Base consumer lending on sound written criteria and a reliable risk rating system

summaries.en: A credit institution's consumer lending must rest on sound criteria defined in writing in advance that do not obviously endanger consumers' ability to pay, and its business model must not lead to lending to consumers with an unreasonably high insolvency risk. It must keep the lending criteria for at least ten years after the end of the year they were last applied, have a risk rating system to monitor insolvency risk, and report arrears, non-performing loans, credit losses and risk ratings to FIN-FSA at least yearly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customer information confidential

titles.en: Keep customer information confidential

summaries.en: Anyone who, as an officer or employee of a credit institution, its group company or agent, learns information about a customer's financial position or personal circumstances or a business secret must keep it confidential. Disclosure is allowed only with the consent of the person protected or where the law permits it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide an account switching service to consumers

titles.en: Provide an account switching service to consumers

summaries.en: A credit institution must offer consumers an account switching service, following the rules in 15 a luku 2–5 § on the information to be given, the fees that may be charged and the duties of the transferring and receiving institutions.

instruments.title: Add Sijoituspalvelulaki, 747/2012
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Sijoituspalvelulaki (747/2012), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Investment Services Act

payload.implementsNote: MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise investment services reliably with effective compliance arrangements

titles.en: Organise investment services reliably with effective compliance arrangements

summaries.en: An investment firm, and a credit institution providing investment services, must organise its business reliably and adopt policies and procedures ensuring that the firm, its management, employees and tied agents comply with the law and the rules on personal transactions. It must take reasonable steps to ensure continuity and regularity of its services using appropriate and proportionate systems, resources and procedures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product governance process for the financial instruments the firm manufactures

titles.en: Run a product governance process for the financial instruments the firm manufactures

summaries.en: A firm that manufactures financial instruments must have an up-to-date product approval process that approves each instrument and significant change before it is marketed or distributed. The process must identify the target market and the clients for whom the instrument is not suitable, assess the relevant risks and costs, and check that the distribution strategy fits the target market.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, prevent and disclose conflicts of interest

titles.en: Identify, prevent and disclose conflicts of interest

summaries.en: The firm must take all appropriate steps to identify and prevent conflicts of interest and, where they arise, treat the client in accordance with good practice. If a conflict cannot be avoided, it must disclose its nature, sources and the mitigating steps to the client in a durable medium before acting for the client, and it must have a policy on the procedures for identifying and preventing conflicts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an insider register of the firm's insiders' holdings

titles.en: Keep an insider register of the firm's insiders' holdings

summaries.en: The firm must keep a register of the declarations its insiders make of their holdings in shares, and instruments whose value derives from them, traded on a Finnish regulated market or MTF; insiders include board members, the chief executive, auditors and staff whose duties involve such instruments. Insiders declare within fourteen days of appointment and report changes within seven days, and register entries are kept for five years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interest

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interest

summaries.en: When providing investment and ancillary services the firm must act honestly, fairly and professionally in accordance with the client's best interest. It must not market services with untrue or misleading information; all information, including marketing communications, must be fair and clear and must be corrected or supplemented without delay if later found misleading.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess suitability and appropriateness before providing investment services

titles.en: Assess suitability and appropriateness before providing investment services

summaries.en: Before giving investment advice or portfolio management, the firm must obtain information on the client's knowledge and experience, financial situation including ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance, so it can recommend suitable services and instruments. For other services the firm must assess whether the product or service is appropriate for the client.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give clients information on the firm, services, instruments and all costs in good time

titles.en: Give clients information on the firm, services, instruments and all costs in good time

summaries.en: In good time before providing a service the firm must give clients adequate information about itself, its services, the financial instruments and proposed strategies, execution venues and all costs and associated charges, including whether any investment advice is independent and how broad its analysis is.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay or accept inducements only where they enhance the quality of the service

titles.en: Pay or accept inducements only where they enhance the quality of the service

summaries.en: The firm may not pay to or accept from anyone other than the client, or a person acting for the client, any fee, commission or non-monetary benefit in connection with an investment or ancillary service unless it is designed to enhance the quality of the service to the client and does not impair the duty to act in the client's best interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing orders

titles.en: Take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing orders

summaries.en: A firm executing client orders must take sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for the client, taking into account price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size, nature and other relevant factors, and must follow any specific instructions from the client. For retail clients the best result is determined by the total consideration.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep records of client orders, transactions and services

titles.en: Keep records of client orders, transactions and services

summaries.en: The firm must keep records of orders received from clients, transactions in financial instruments carried out for its own or clients' account and other services provided to clients for five years, and for up to seven years if FIN-FSA so requests.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record telephone conversations and electronic communications relating to transactions

titles.en: Record telephone conversations and electronic communications relating to transactions

summaries.en: The firm must record and keep telephone conversations and electronic communications relating to dealing on own account and to the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, including those intended to lead to such transactions, and must take all reasonable steps to record them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail clients access to an independent dispute resolution body

titles.en: Give retail clients access to an independent dispute resolution body

summaries.en: The firm must ensure that its retail clients can take individual disputes about the application of the Act to an independent body that issues recommendations and handles cases impartially, openly and fairly, and must notify FIN-FSA of the body's name and contact details.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold client assets reliably and keep them segregated from the firm's own

titles.en: Hold client assets reliably and keep them segregated from the firm's own

summaries.en: The firm must hold and handle the financial instruments and funds entrusted to it by clients reliably, keep them clearly separate from its own assets and, unless it is a credit institution, prevent the use of client funds for its own account. It must keep reliable records of client assets.

instruments.title: Add Arvopaperimarkkinalaki, 746/2012
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Arvopaperimarkkinalaki (746/2012), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Securities Markets Act

payload.implementsNote: Transparency Directive 2004/109/EC as amended by Directive 2013/50/EU; Takeover Bids Directive 2004/25/EC; Directive (EU) 2024/2810; supplements MAR, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not act contrary to good securities market practice

titles.en: Do not act contrary to good securities market practice

summaries.en: No one, including a firm dealing, advising or issuing on the securities markets, may act there in a way that is contrary to good securities market practice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give no untrue or misleading information when marketing or trading securities

titles.en: Give no untrue or misleading information when marketing or trading securities

summaries.en: When marketing or trading securities and other financial instruments in the course of business, and when meeting disclosure duties under the Act, a firm must not give untrue or misleading information. Information later found untrue or misleading that may matter to investors must be corrected or supplemented without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain to FIN-FSA on request why disclosure of inside information was delayed

titles.en: Explain to FIN-FSA on request why disclosure of inside information was delayed

summaries.en: An issuer that has delayed the public disclosure of inside information under Article 17(4) MAR must, when FIN-FSA asks, provide its written explanation of how the conditions for the delay were met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish annual financial statements and half-yearly reports on time

titles.en: Publish annual financial statements and half-yearly reports on time

summaries.en: An issuer must publish its financial statements and report of the board of directors without undue delay, at least three weeks before the general meeting that adopts them and no later than four months after the end of the financial year, in the single electronic reporting format. It must also publish a half-yearly report for the first six months of the financial year, subject to the exemptions for certain debt-only issuers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify major holdings when a flagging threshold is crossed

titles.en: Notify major holdings when a flagging threshold is crossed

summaries.en: A shareholder must notify the target company and FIN-FSA when its share of voting rights or shares reaches, exceeds or falls below 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50 or 90 percent or two thirds. The notification must be made without undue delay and at the latest on the trading day after the shareholder learned or should have learned of the transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate an internal channel for reporting suspected breaches as an issuer

titles.en: Operate an internal channel for reporting suspected breaches as an issuer

summaries.en: An issuer must have a procedure through which its employees can report suspected breaches of financial market rules internally through an independent channel, with proper handling of reports and protection of the reporter's identity and personal data.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep managers' transaction notifications available on the website for five years

titles.en: Keep managers' transaction notifications available on the website for five years

summaries.en: An issuer whose instruments are traded on a regulated market, or on an MTF at its request, must keep the information on transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities and their closely associated persons, notified and published under Article 19 MAR, publicly available on its website for at least five years.

instruments.title: Add Rikoslaki, 39/1889
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Rikoslaki (39/1889), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Criminal Code

payload.implementsNote: Chapter 51: CSMAD, Directive 2014/57/EU on criminal sanctions for market abuse

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not use or unlawfully disclose inside information
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Rikoslaki (39/1889), 51 luku 1 §, 2 a §, 6 a § ja 8 §

titles.en: Do not use or unlawfully disclose inside information

summaries.en: Using inside information on a financial instrument or crypto-asset, intentionally or through gross negligence, to buy or sell, to cancel or amend an order, or to recommend a trade to someone else, is the crime of misuse of inside information, and unlawfully passing on inside information is a separate offence. The offences apply to instruments traded or seeking admission on a regulated market, MTF, OTF or crypto trading platform, and a company can be fined under corporate criminal liability.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not manipulate the market

titles.en: Do not manipulate the market

summaries.en: Giving orders or entering transactions that give false or misleading signals about supply, demand or price, secure an abnormal or artificial price or use fictitious devices, or spreading misleading information for gain, is the crime of market manipulation for financial instruments, crypto-assets and related spot commodity contracts. A company can be fined under corporate criminal liability.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give no false information on securities and meet statutory disclosure duties

titles.en: Give no false information on securities and meet statutory disclosure duties

summaries.en: Giving untrue or misleading information in the marketing or trading of financial instruments, or failing to disclose information required by the Securities Markets Act or the Prospectus Regulation that could materially affect a security's value, intentionally or through gross negligence, is a securities markets information offence.

instruments.title: Add Rahanpesulaki, 444/2017
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), consolidated text in force

titles.fi: Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä
titles.en: Act on Preventing Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing

payload.implementsNote: AMLD4, Directive (EU) 2015/849, as amended by AMLD5, Directive (EU) 2018/843

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare and update a business-wide money laundering and terrorist financing risk assessment
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 2 luku 3 §

titles.en: Prepare and update a business-wide money laundering and terrorist financing risk assessment

summaries.en: An obliged entity must prepare a risk assessment identifying and assessing its money laundering and terrorist financing risks, taking into account the nature, size and scope of its business, keep it regularly updated and deliver it to its supervisor on request. It must have adequate policies, procedures and controls to mitigate and manage the risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify customers and verify their identity before establishing a relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 1–2 §

titles.en: Identify customers and verify their identity before establishing a relationship

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify its customers and verify their identity when establishing a customer relationship and for occasional transactions at or above the thresholds, such as 10 000 euros, and must not keep anonymous accounts. If customer due diligence cannot be completed, it must not establish the relationship or carry out the transaction, and a credit institution must not execute payment transactions through a payment account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customer due diligence records up to date for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 3 §

titles.en: Keep customer due diligence records up to date for five years

summaries.en: An obliged entity must keep all customer due diligence and transaction documents and data up to date and relevant, and retain them reliably for five years after the customer relationship ends or, for an occasional transaction, after it is carried out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor customer activity and investigate unusual transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 4 §

titles.en: Monitor customer activity and investigate unusual transactions

summaries.en: An obliged entity must obtain information on the customer's and beneficial owner's activities and the purpose of the service, and monitor the relationship in a way that fits its nature and risks so that activity matches what is known of the customer. It must pay particular attention to transactions that are unusual in structure or size or have no apparent economic purpose, and establish the origin of funds where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify customers' beneficial owners and keep the information current
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 6 §

titles.en: Identify customers' beneficial owners and keep the information current

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify its customers' beneficial owners, maintain adequate, accurate and up-to-date information on them and verify their identity where necessary, and must establish with appropriate care whether someone else exercises control over a corporate customer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence to higher-risk customers and transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 10 §

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence to higher-risk customers and transactions

summaries.en: An obliged entity must apply enhanced customer due diligence in the cases listed in the Act, such as remote identification, correspondent relationships, politically exposed persons and high-risk third countries, whenever its risk assessment indicates a higher than usual risk, and where the customer or transaction is linked to a country whose regime the Commission considers deficient.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence before entering correspondent relationships
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 12 §

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence before entering correspondent relationships

summaries.en: Before a credit or financial institution enters a correspondent relationship with an institution outside the EEA, it must gather enough information to understand the respondent's business, assess its reputation, the quality of its supervision and its AML controls, obtain senior management approval and agree the due diligence responsibilities in writing. It must not start or continue a relationship with a shell bank or an institution whose accounts shell banks may use.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect politically exposed persons and apply enhanced measures to them
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 13 §

titles.en: Detect politically exposed persons and apply enhanced measures to them

summaries.en: An obliged entity must have risk-based procedures to establish whether a customer or beneficial owner is, or has been, a politically exposed person, or a family member or close associate of one. For such customers senior management must approve the relationship, the source of wealth and funds must be established and the relationship must be subject to enhanced ongoing monitoring.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced measures to transactions linked to high-risk third countries
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 13 a §

titles.en: Apply enhanced measures to transactions linked to high-risk third countries

summaries.en: When transactions or payments involve third countries the Commission has identified as high-risk, an obliged entity must obtain additional information on the customer, the beneficial owner, the purpose of the relationship, the source of funds and wealth and the reasons for the transactions, obtain senior management approval, and apply enhanced ongoing monitoring.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain policies and controls to comply with sanctions and freezing decisions
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 3 luku 16 §

titles.en: Maintain policies and controls to comply with sanctions and freezing decisions

summaries.en: As part of customer due diligence an obliged entity must have effective policies, procedures and internal control to ensure it complies with EU sanctions regulations, the national sanctions decrees under the Sanctions Act (659/1967) and national asset freezing decisions under Act 325/2013.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report suspicious transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 4 luku 1 §

titles.en: Report suspicious transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay

summaries.en: After investigating an unusual transaction, an obliged entity must report a suspicious transaction to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay, whether or not the relationship was established or the transaction carried out, suspended or refused.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not disclose a suspicious transaction report to the customer or others
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 4 luku 4 §

titles.en: Do not disclose a suspicious transaction report to the customer or others

summaries.en: An obliged entity and its employees must not reveal to the person concerned or anyone else that a suspicious transaction report has been made or is being investigated, apart from the exceptions the Act allows, such as sharing within a group.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Suspend or refuse suspicious transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 4 luku 5 §

titles.en: Suspend or refuse suspicious transactions

summaries.en: An obliged entity must suspend a transaction for further checks or refuse it if the transaction is suspicious or it suspects the funds are meant for terrorist financing. If the transaction cannot be stopped, or stopping it would hinder tracing the beneficiary, it may be completed and then reported.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate an internal channel for reporting suspected AML breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 7 luku 8 §

titles.en: Operate an internal channel for reporting suspected AML breaches

summaries.en: An obliged entity must have procedures through which its employees and agents can report suspected breaches of the AML Act and rules issued under it internally through an independent channel, unless its supervisor has decided otherwise for a small entity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train staff and appoint a person responsible for AML compliance
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estämisestä (444/2017), 9 luku 1 §

titles.en: Train staff and appoint a person responsible for AML compliance

summaries.en: An obliged entity must ensure that its employees are trained to comply with the AML Act and rules issued under it, appoint a member of management responsible for supervising compliance and, where justified by its size and nature, a compliance officer. An entity that is part of a group must also follow group-wide AML procedures, including information sharing within the group.

instruments.title: Add Maksupalvelulaki, 290/2010
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Maksupalvelulaki (290/2010), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Payment Services Act

payload.implementsNote: PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366; Payment Accounts Directive 2014/92/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give payment service users the prescribed information before a framework contract

titles.en: Give payment service users the prescribed information before a framework contract

summaries.en: In good time before a framework contract is concluded, the payment service provider must give the user, on paper or another durable medium, the information on the provider, the payment services, communication, safeguards, liability, redress and how the contract can be changed and terminated.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit payments to the payee's provider by the next business day

titles.en: Credit payments to the payee's provider by the next business day

summaries.en: The payer's payment service provider must credit the amount of a payment to the payee's provider's account no later than the business day after receiving the payment order, or the second business day for paper-initiated payments; instant credit transfers follow the timing in the SEPA Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Block a payment instrument when it is reported lost or misused

titles.en: Block a payment instrument when it is reported lost or misused

summaries.en: The payment service provider must prevent the use of a payment instrument as soon as the holder notifies it of its loss, theft or unauthorised use.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund unauthorised payment transactions by the next business day

titles.en: Refund unauthorised payment transactions by the next business day

summaries.en: Where a payment transaction was unauthorised, the provider whose customer's funds were used must refund the amount, or restore the account, immediately and no later than the business day after noticing or being notified of the transaction, unless the payer is liable under 62 §, or the provider has justified grounds to suspect fraud and reports them in writing to FIN-FSA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply strong customer authentication to online access and electronic payments

titles.en: Apply strong customer authentication to online access and electronic payments

summaries.en: The payment service provider must use strong customer authentication when the payer accesses the payment account online, initiates an electronic payment transaction or carries out any remote action that may involve a risk of fraud; for remote electronic payments the authentication must be linked dynamically to the amount and the payee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer payment service complaints within fifteen business days

titles.en: Answer payment service complaints within fifteen business days

summaries.en: The payment service provider must have effective procedures for handling user complaints and must reply on paper or another agreed durable medium, addressing all points raised, within 15 business days of receipt. In exceptional cases it may send a holding reply, but the final reply must reach the user within 35 business days.

instruments.title: Add Maksulaitoslaki, 297/2010
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Maksulaitoslaki (297/2010), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Payment Institutions Act

payload.implementsNote: PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366; E-Money Directive 2009/110/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide payment services only with an EEA authorisation

titles.en: Provide payment services only with an EEA authorisation

summaries.en: Payment services may be provided only with an authorisation granted in the EEA under the Act, and an e-money institution's authorisation must expressly cover issuing electronic money.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the payment institution's business reliably with adequate risk management

titles.en: Organise the payment institution's business reliably with adequate risk management

summaries.en: A payment institution must organise its business reliably, must not take risks that materially endanger its solvency or liquidity, and must have governance enabling effective risk management with adequate internal control and risk management systems.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage operational and security risks and major incidents

titles.en: Manage operational and security risks and major incidents

summaries.en: A payment institution, a person providing payment services under an exemption and an account information service provider must have a risk management framework of mitigation measures and control mechanisms for the operational and security risks of their payment services, and an effective incident management procedure able to detect and classify major operational and security incidents, without prejudice to DORA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard funds received from payment service users

titles.en: Safeguard funds received from payment service users

summaries.en: A payment institution must protect funds received from users or other providers for executing payments, or in exchange for e-money, by keeping them separate so that they cannot be mixed with other funds and, if they have not been paid out or transferred by the business day after receipt, depositing them in an account at a central bank or credit institution or investing them in low-risk liquid assets, or by the alternative protection the section allows.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give payment institutions access to bank account services on non-discriminatory terms

titles.en: Give payment institutions access to bank account services on non-discriminatory terms

summaries.en: A credit institution that offers payment account services must offer them to payment institutions and to exempt payment and account information service providers on an objective, non-discriminatory and proportionate basis that allows them to provide their services unhindered. If it refuses, it must notify FIN-FSA of the refusal and the reasons.

instruments.title: Add Sijoitusrahastolaki, 213/2019
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Sijoitusrahastolaki (213/2019), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Mutual Funds Act

payload.implementsNote: UCITS Directive 2009/65/EC as amended, including Directive (EU) 2024/927

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage UCITS funds only as an authorised management company

titles.en: Manage UCITS funds only as an authorised management company

summaries.en: Only a management company authorised for this business may manage a mutual fund under the Act and carry on mutual fund business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage funds in unitholders' interest and treat them equally

titles.en: Manage funds in unitholders' interest and treat them equally

summaries.en: A management company must carry on its business diligently, independently and expertly in the interests of the fund and its unitholders, treat unitholders equally, avoid conflicts of interest when organising its business and, where they arise, ensure the funds and unitholders are treated fairly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain adequate internal control and risk management

titles.en: Maintain adequate internal control and risk management

summaries.en: A management company must not take risks that materially endanger its solvency and must have internal control and risk management systems adequate for its business, with ICT controls meeting DORA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Select at least two liquidity management tools for each fund and notify FIN-FSA

titles.en: Select at least two liquidity management tools for each fund and notify FIN-FSA

summaries.en: For each mutual fund the management company must select at least two suitable liquidity management tools from those listed in the Act, assess their suitability against the fund's investment strategy, liquidity profile and redemption policy, and notify the selected tools to FIN-FSA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide the key information document to investors before subscription

titles.en: Provide the key information document to investors before subscription

summaries.en: A management company selling fund units directly or through persons acting on its responsibility must give the investor the key investor information in good time before the subscription; a PRIIPs key information document may be used to meet this duty.

instruments.title: Add Laki vaihtoehtorahastojen hoitajista, 162/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki vaihtoehtorahastojen hoitajista (162/2014), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Alternative Investment Fund Managers

payload.implementsNote: AIFMD, Directive 2011/61/EU, as amended by Directive (EU) 2024/927

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage alternative investment funds only with an authorisation

titles.en: Manage alternative investment funds only with an authorisation

summaries.en: An alternative investment fund may be managed only by a manager authorised under the Act, although a manager that is only required to register may manage funds without authorisation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report regularly to FIN-FSA on each fund managed

titles.en: Report regularly to FIN-FSA on each fund managed

summaries.en: The manager must report regularly to FIN-FSA for each fund it manages on the markets and instruments it trades, its principal exposures, most important concentrations, leverage and other factors relevant to systemic risk; reporting on each fund's positions and assets applies from 16 April 2027.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and prevent conflicts of interest and segregate conflicting duties

titles.en: Identify and prevent conflicts of interest and segregate conflicting duties

summaries.en: The manager must take reasonable steps to identify and prevent conflicts of interest, treat investors in accordance with good securities market practice when they arise, and separate tasks and responsibilities that may be incompatible with each other.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain risk and liquidity management for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki vaihtoehtorahastojen hoitajista (162/2014), 8 luku 1 § ja 6 §

titles.en: Maintain risk and liquidity management for each fund

summaries.en: The manager must have adequate internal control and risk management arrangements, reviewed at least annually, to identify, measure, manage and monitor all material risks of each fund, and liquidity arrangements ensuring that each fund's investment strategy, liquidity profile and redemption policy are consistent, backed by regular liquidity stress tests; the liquidity rules do not apply to unleveraged closed-ended funds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make material fund information available to investors before they invest

titles.en: Make material fund information available to investors before they invest

summaries.en: A manager whose funds are marketed in Finland or another EEA state must make material and sufficient information on each EEA fund available to investors before they invest, and keep material changes to that information available.

instruments.title: Add Vakuutusyhtiölaki, 521/2008
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Vakuutusyhtiölaki (521/2008), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Insurance Companies Act

payload.implementsNote: Solvency II, Directive 2009/138/EC

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain an adequate system of governance

titles.en: Maintain an adequate system of governance

summaries.en: An insurance company must have a system of governance adequate to the nature and scale of its business, with clearly defined, allocated and segregated responsibilities that allows sound and prudent management and ensures the flow of information in the company, meeting the requirements of 6 luku 9–20 §.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Define key functions and ensure their holders are fit and proper

titles.en: Define key functions and ensure their holders are fit and proper

summaries.en: The board of an insurance company must define the company's key functions, and the persons responsible for them must be of good repute and have the professional qualifications and experience the task requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate a risk management system covering all risks

titles.en: Operate a risk management system covering all risks

summaries.en: An insurance company must have a risk management system that covers the risks included in the solvency capital requirement and those that are not, with continuous identification, measurement, monitoring, management and reporting of individual and aggregated risks, and a risk management strategy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out the own risk and solvency assessment regularly

titles.en: Carry out the own risk and solvency assessment regularly

summaries.en: An insurance company must carry out its own risk and solvency assessment regularly and without delay after any significant change in its risk profile; from 30 January 2027 the assessment must be made at least annually.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish an annual solvency and financial condition report

titles.en: Publish an annual solvency and financial condition report

summaries.en: An insurance company must publish each year a board-approved report on its solvency and financial condition and deliver it to FIN-FSA when published, in the format required by the ESAP Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cover the solvency and minimum capital requirements at all times

titles.en: Cover the solvency and minimum capital requirements at all times

summaries.en: An insurance company must at all times cover its solvency capital requirement and minimum capital requirement with own funds of sufficient quality and amount, calculating the solvency capital requirement at least annually and the minimum capital requirement at least quarterly.

instruments.title: Add Laki vakuutusten tarjoamisesta, 234/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki vakuutusten tarjoamisesta (234/2018), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Insurance Distribution

payload.implementsNote: IDD, Directive (EU) 2016/97

obligations.title: Add the duty: Distribute insurance only as a registered intermediary or an insurer

titles.en: Distribute insurance only as a registered intermediary or an insurer

summaries.en: Insurance may be distributed in Finland only by insurers, by intermediaries and ancillary intermediaries registered in the Finnish register of insurance intermediaries or notified from another EEA state, and by the exempt ancillary intermediaries described in the Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the professional competence of insurance distribution staff up to date

titles.en: Keep the professional competence of insurance distribution staff up to date

summaries.en: Persons taking part in or responsible for insurance distribution must continuously maintain and develop their professional competence to a level adequate for the nature and scope of their tasks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interest

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the customer's best interest

summaries.en: An insurance distributor must act honestly, fairly, professionally, carefully and in the customer's best interest, following good insurance practice, and must not be remunerated, or remunerate or assess its staff, in a way that conflicts with that duty.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer consumers the insurance and the other product separately

titles.en: Offer consumers the insurance and the other product separately

summaries.en: When insurance is offered to a consumer together with goods or a service other than insurance, the consumer must also be offered the possibility to buy the insurance and the goods or service separately.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate a product approval process for insurance products

titles.en: Operate a product approval process for insurance products

summaries.en: An insurer must maintain and review a product approval process that approves new products and significant changes before they are marketed, identifies a target market for each product, assesses the relevant risks for that market and checks that the distribution strategy fits it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not use old cancer diagnoses in credit-linked consumer insurance

titles.en: Do not use old cancer diagnoses in credit-linked consumer insurance

summaries.en: From 20 November 2026, where a consumer credit offer requires the consumer to take out insurance linked to the credit, the insurer must not use personal data on the consumer's cancer diagnosis once 15 years have passed since the end of the medical treatment.

instruments.title: Add Kuluttajansuojalaki, 38/1978
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Kuluttajansuojalaki (38/1978), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Consumer Protection Act

payload.implementsNote: Consumer credit (chapters 7 and 7 a): CCD, Directive 2008/48/EC; MCD, Directive 2014/17/EU; CCD2, Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (amendments applying from 20 November 2026)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the standard European credit information before a credit agreement

titles.en: Give the consumer the standard European credit information before a credit agreement

summaries.en: In good time before a consumer credit agreement is concluded, the creditor and any credit intermediary must give the consumer clear and understandable pre-contractual information on paper or another durable medium chosen by the consumer, using the Standard European Consumer Credit Information form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Lend responsibly and follow good lending practice

titles.en: Lend responsibly and follow good lending practice

summaries.en: A creditor must act responsibly in consumer lending; for example, its marketing must not play down the seriousness of borrowing, suggest that credit solves financial problems or make unfounded claims that it is cheaper than existing credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness before granting credit

titles.en: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness before granting credit

summaries.en: Before concluding a credit agreement the creditor must assess whether the consumer can meet the obligations, using sufficient information on income and other financial circumstances from the credit information register and other sources, and must update the information before raising a credit amount or limit. From 20 November 2026 the assessment must be made thoroughly and in the consumer's interest on the basis of necessary and proportionate information on income, expenses and circumstances.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Verify the consumer's identity carefully, using strong electronic identification online

titles.en: Verify the consumer's identity carefully, using strong electronic identification online

summaries.en: When concluding a consumer credit agreement or raising a credit amount or limit, the creditor must verify the consumer's identity carefully; if identity is verified electronically, it must use a method that meets the strong electronic identification requirements or strong customer authentication under the Payment Services Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep consumer credit interest and other costs within the statutory caps

titles.en: Keep consumer credit interest and other costs within the statutory caps

summaries.en: The agreed interest on consumer credit may not exceed the reference rate under the Interest Act plus 15 percentage points and in any case not 20 percent, and other credit costs are capped at 0.01 percent of the credit amount or limit per day, subject to the section's detailed rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Honour the consumer's 14-day right of withdrawal

titles.en: Honour the consumer's 14-day right of withdrawal

summaries.en: A consumer may withdraw from a consumer credit agreement by notifying the creditor within 14 days of concluding it or of receiving the contract terms, whichever is later; the creditor may then claim only interest for the time the credit was available and any non-refundable charges it paid to authorities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Warn in consumer credit advertising that borrowing costs money

titles.en: Warn in consumer credit advertising that borrowing costs money

summaries.en: From 20 November 2026 all consumer credit advertising must clearly and prominently warn that taking out credit costs the consumer money, with the content of the warning set by government decree.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell applicants promptly when a credit application is rejected

titles.en: Tell applicants promptly when a credit application is rejected

summaries.en: From 20 November 2026 a creditor must inform a consumer without delay when a credit application is rejected, where needed refer the consumer to debt counselling, and on request give the reason for the rejection in writing, unless the refusal is based on the AML suspension rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the ESIS form before a housing credit agreement

titles.en: Give the ESIS form before a housing credit agreement

summaries.en: After the consumer has given information on needs, expectations and financial circumstances, and in good time before a housing credit agreement is concluded, the creditor and any intermediary must give personalised pre-contractual information on a durable medium using the ESIS form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly before a housing credit

titles.en: Assess creditworthiness thoroughly before a housing credit

summaries.en: Before concluding a housing credit agreement the creditor must thoroughly assess the consumer's creditworthiness on the basis of necessary, sufficient and proportionate information on income, expenses and other circumstances from the credit information register and other sources, and verify that the information is accurate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Limit housing loan repayment periods to 40 years

titles.en: Limit housing loan repayment periods to 40 years

summaries.en: A creditor may not use terms under which a housing credit's repayment period at the time of granting exceeds 40 years from drawdown, although up to 10 percent of its housing lending in each quarter may exceed the limit.

instruments.title: Add Tietosuojalaki, 1050/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Tietosuojalaki (1050/2018), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Data Protection Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process personal identity codes only where permitted and never as the sole means of identification

titles.en: Process personal identity codes only where permitted and never as the sole means of identification

summaries.en: A personal identity code may be processed with the data subject's consent, where the law provides, or where unambiguous identification is important, for example in lending, debt collection, insurance, credit institution and payment service activity. It must not be printed needlessly on documents, and identification must not rely on the code alone or on the code and name only.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process data on criminal convictions and offences only on the permitted grounds

titles.en: Process data on criminal convictions and offences only on the permitted grounds

summaries.en: Personal data on criminal convictions and offences may be processed only where needed for legal claims, where necessary for an insurer assessing its liability, where the law provides or a statutory public-interest task requires it, or for research and statistics, with measures to protect the data subject's rights.

instruments.title: Add Laki Finanssivalvonnasta, 878/2008
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki Finanssivalvonnasta (878/2008), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Financial Supervisory Authority

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide FIN-FSA with the information it requests and its regular reports

titles.en: Provide FIN-FSA with the information it requests and its regular reports

summaries.en: A supervised entity must, notwithstanding secrecy, deliver to FIN-FSA without undue delay the information and reports FIN-FSA requests for its statutory tasks, and must report regularly on its financial position, owners, internal control and risk management, management and offices as FIN-FSA's regulations require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give FIN-FSA access for inspections

titles.en: Give FIN-FSA access for inspections

summaries.en: A supervised entity must let FIN-FSA inspect, at its premises and notwithstanding secrecy, the documents, recordings of telephone and electronic communications, other traffic data and information systems concerning its business and administration, to the extent FIN-FSA needs them for supervision.

instruments.title: Add Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista, 151/2022
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Mortgage Credit Banks and Covered Bonds

payload.implementsNote: Covered Bonds Directive (EU) 2019/2162

obligations.title: Add the duty: Issue covered bonds only with a covered bond permit
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 3 §

titles.en: Issue covered bonds only with a covered bond permit

summaries.en: Mortgage credit bank business, meaning the issuing of covered bonds under the Act, may be carried on only by a mortgage credit bank or other credit institution that has received the permit referred to in 8 §.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the cover pool above the covered bond liabilities with the minimum overcollateralisation
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 24 §

titles.en: Keep the cover pool above the covered bond liabilities with the minimum overcollateralisation

summaries.en: The total value of the cover pool must continuously exceed the value of the payment obligations under the covered bonds, with overcollateralisation of at least 2 percent, or at least 5 percent where the conditions of Article 129(3a) CRR are not met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a tamper-proof register of covered bonds and their cover pools
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 27 §

titles.en: Keep a tamper-proof register of covered bonds and their cover pools

summaries.en: The issuer must keep a register of the covered bonds it has issued and their cover pools, enter changes without delay and keep an unalterable record of the entries, so that the cover pool assets securing each bond can be identified.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold a cover pool liquidity buffer for 180 days of net outflows
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 31 §

titles.en: Hold a cover pool liquidity buffer for 180 days of net outflows

summaries.en: The issuer must ensure that the cover pool continuously contains eligible liquid assets covering the maximum cumulative net liquidity outflow of the covered bonds over the next 180 days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish covered bond and cover pool information quarterly
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 36 §

titles.en: Publish covered bond and cover pool information quarterly

summaries.en: The issuer must publish on its website at least quarterly information on its covered bonds and cover pools, including the total value of the cover assets and outstanding bonds and the bonds' international identifiers, among the items listed in the section.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report covered bond and cover pool data to FIN-FSA quarterly
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kiinnitysluottopankeista ja katetuista joukkolainoista (151/2022), 38 §

titles.en: Report covered bond and cover pool data to FIN-FSA quarterly

summaries.en: The issuer must report to FIN-FSA quarterly, and whenever FIN-FSA requires, on the covered bonds issued, the cover pools and their valuation and the other matters listed in the section.

instruments.title: Add Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä, 186/2023
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä (186/2023), consolidated text in force

titles.fi: Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä
titles.en: Act on the Registration of Certain Credit Providers and Credit Intermediaries

payload.shortName: Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä
payload.implementsNote: Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (amendments by Act 32/2026 applying from 20 November 2026)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with FIN-FSA before granting consumer credit or intermediating peer-to-peer loans
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä (186/2023), 3–4 §

titles.en: Register with FIN-FSA before granting consumer credit or intermediating peer-to-peer loans

summaries.en: A business other than a credit institution may grant consumer credit or credit to housing companies only if registered as a credit provider, and may intermediate peer-to-peer loans only if registered as an intermediary or credit provider; it must file a registration notification with FIN-FSA, which keeps the register. Credit institutions are outside the Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base consumer lending on sound written criteria that protect consumers' ability to pay
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä (186/2023), 13 §

titles.en: Base consumer lending on sound written criteria that protect consumers' ability to pay

summaries.en: A registered credit provider's consumer lending must rest on sound criteria defined in writing in advance that do not obviously endanger consumers' ability to pay, and its business model must not lead to lending to consumers with an unreasonably high insolvency risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Respect the maximum loan-to-collateral ratio for housing credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä (186/2023), 14 §

titles.en: Respect the maximum loan-to-collateral ratio for housing credit

summaries.en: A registered credit provider may grant consumer credit secured on a home for buying or renovating a dwelling only up to the loan-to-collateral ratio set in the section.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep lending and intermediation records for five years after the credit falls due
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki eräiden luotonantajien ja luotonvälittäjien rekisteröinnistä (186/2023), 16 §

titles.en: Keep lending and intermediation records for five years after the credit falls due

summaries.en: Unless a longer period applies, a credit provider or peer-to-peer intermediary must keep the documents and data on its lending and intermediation for five years after the credit has fallen due in full, and longer if a dispute arises.

instruments.title: Add Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta, 1194/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta (1194/2014), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Resolution of Credit Institutions and Investment Firms

payload.implementsNote: BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU, as amended by Directive (EU) 2019/879

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide the Financial Stability Authority with the information needed for resolution planning
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta (1194/2014), 2 luku 4 §

titles.en: Provide the Financial Stability Authority with the information needed for resolution planning

summaries.en: An institution must deliver to the Financial Stability Authority the information and analyses needed to draw up, maintain and implement its resolution plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta (1194/2014), 8 luku 7 §

titles.en: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities at all times

summaries.en: An institution must at all times hold the amount of own funds and eligible liabilities set by the Financial Stability Authority as its minimum requirement (MREL), calculated as the Act provides.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include contractual recognition of bail-in in relevant liability contracts
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta (1194/2014), 8 luku 12 a §

titles.en: Include contractual recognition of bail-in in relevant liability contracts

summaries.en: An institution must include in the contracts creating the liabilities covered by the section a term by which the creditor recognises and accepts that the liability may be written down, converted or cancelled by decision of the Financial Stability Authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report and disclose MREL-eligible liabilities
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki luottolaitosten ja sijoituspalveluyritysten kriisinratkaisusta (1194/2014), 8 luku 14 §

titles.en: Report and disclose MREL-eligible liabilities

summaries.en: An institution must report to the Financial Stability Authority and FIN-FSA half-yearly the amount of its eligible liabilities and own funds, and yearly the amount of other bail-inable liabilities and the composition and insolvency ranking of these items. It must also publish at least yearly its MREL requirement and the amount, composition, maturity profile and ranking of its own funds and eligible liabilities.

instruments.title: Add Laki rahoitusvakausviranomaisesta, 1195/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki rahoitusvakausviranomaisesta (1195/2014), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Financial Stability Authority

payload.implementsNote: DGSD, Directive 2014/49/EU; BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU (resolution financing)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep systems that can determine each depositor's covered deposits at any time

titles.en: Keep systems that can determine each depositor's covered deposits at any time

summaries.en: A deposit bank must have internal systems that allow the eligible and covered deposits of each depositor to be determined at any time, and must deliver that information to the Financial Stability Authority on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay deposit guarantee contributions when due

titles.en: Pay deposit guarantee contributions when due

summaries.en: When the Deposit Guarantee Fund falls below its minimum level a deposit bank must pay the annual contribution calculated under the Act, and a new deposit bank must pay an entry fee to the deposit guarantee scheme.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform depositors about deposit protection

titles.en: Inform depositors about deposit protection

summaries.en: A deposit bank must give its depositors adequate information on deposit protection and on changes to information given earlier, with the detailed content set by Ministry of Finance decree.

instruments.title: Add Laki pankki- ja maksutilien valvontajärjestelmästä, 571/2019
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki pankki- ja maksutilien valvontajärjestelmästä (571/2019), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Bank and Payment Account Monitoring System

payload.implementsNote: AMLD5, Directive (EU) 2018/843 (centralised bank account mechanisms)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain an electronic data retrieval system for authorities' account queries
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki pankki- ja maksutilien valvontajärjestelmästä (571/2019), 1 d §

titles.en: Maintain an electronic data retrieval system for authorities' account queries

summaries.en: A credit institution must maintain an electronic bank and payment account data retrieval system through which it discloses to competent authorities, notwithstanding secrecy, the customer and account data, and from 1 June 2026 the balance and transaction data, referred to in chapters 2 and 3; FIN-FSA may grant an exemption where the institution's size and the nature and scope of its business justify it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deliver account data to the bank and payment account register
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki pankki- ja maksutilien valvontajärjestelmästä (571/2019), 6 §

titles.en: Deliver account data to the bank and payment account register

summaries.en: Payment institutions, e-money institutions and crypto-asset service providers must, notwithstanding secrecy, give Finnish Customs the customer and account data listed in the section for the bank and payment account register, unless they disclose it through their own data retrieval system.

instruments.title: Add Laki positiivisesta luottotietorekisteristä, 739/2022
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki positiivisesta luottotietorekisteristä (739/2022), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Positive Credit Register

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report consumer credits to the positive credit register on time

titles.en: Report consumer credits to the positive credit register on time

summaries.en: A creditor supervised by FIN-FSA, a registered credit provider or another creditor covered by the Act must report its consumer credits and the prescribed borrower, credit, interest, collateral, repayment and arrears data to the positive credit register kept by the Tax Administration's Incomes Register Unit, at the latest on the calendar day after the credit agreement is concluded, with later changes reported by the second working day after they occur.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with the Incomes Register Unit before reporting starts

titles.en: Register with the Incomes Register Unit before reporting starts

summaries.en: A creditor with a reporting duty must register with the Incomes Register Unit as a reporting creditor at least one month before it starts reporting data to the positive credit register.

instruments.title: Add Verotusmenettelylaki, 1558/1995
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki verotusmenettelystä (1558/1995), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Tax Procedure

payload.implementsNote: DAC, Council Directive 2011/16/EU as amended, including Council Directive (EU) 2018/822 (DAC6)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report payments made to customers to the Tax Administration

titles.en: Report payments made to customers to the Tax Administration

summaries.en: Anyone who pays or mediates payments of monetary value, such as interest, dividends, fund returns, pensions and insurance compensation, must give the Tax Administration the information needed for taxation on the payments, corrections, recipients and grounds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify US reportable accounts and report them under the FATCA agreement

titles.en: Identify US reportable accounts and report them under the FATCA agreement

summaries.en: A Finnish reporting financial institution under the FATCA agreement with the United States must give the Tax Administration the information needed to apply the agreement and follow the agreement's obligations and the due diligence procedure in its Annex I to identify US reportable accounts and accounts held by non-participating financial institutions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable cross-border arrangements as an intermediary

titles.en: Report reportable cross-border arrangements as an intermediary

summaries.en: A Finnish intermediary under the Act on reportable arrangements in the field of taxation must give the Tax Administration the information on reportable cross-border arrangements in its knowledge, possession or control, notify other intermediaries and relevant taxpayers as that Act requires, and pass on the arrangement's reference number.

instruments.title: Add Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla, 1042/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla (1042/2025), consolidated text in force

titles.fi: Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla
titles.en: Act on the Reporting Obligations of Reporting Financial Institutions in the Field of Taxation

payload.shortName: Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla
payload.implementsNote: Council Directive (EU) 2023/2226 (DAC8) amending the DAC; implements the Common Reporting Standard under the multilateral competent authority agreement

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the CRS due diligence procedures to identify reportable accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla (1042/2025), 2 luku (73–102 §)

titles.en: Apply the CRS due diligence procedures to identify reportable accounts

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must review its pre-existing and new individual and entity accounts under the due diligence procedures of chapter 2, including residence tests, electronic and paper record searches, relationship manager enquiries and change-of-circumstances rules, to identify reportable accounts and controlling persons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain and validate a self-certification when a new individual account is opened
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla (1042/2025), 86 §

titles.en: Obtain and validate a self-certification when a new individual account is opened

summaries.en: When a new individual account is opened, the reporting financial institution must obtain a self-certification that allows it to determine the account holder's tax residences and confirm its reasonableness against the information collected at account opening, including AML/KYC documentation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record and keep due diligence evidence for at least six years
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla (1042/2025), 103 §

titles.en: Record and keep due diligence evidence for at least six years

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must record the steps taken and evidence relied on to meet its due diligence and reporting obligations, and keep the records available for at least six years after the end of the calendar year they concern, including after an account is closed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable accounts to the Tax Administration by the end of January
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki raportoivien finanssilaitosten tiedonantovelvollisuudesta verotuksen alalla (1042/2025), 104 §

titles.en: Report reportable accounts to the Tax Administration by the end of January

summaries.en: Each calendar year a reporting financial institution must report the prescribed information on reportable accounts, or that it had none, to the Tax Administration by the end of the following January, using the Tax Administration's electronic filing channel; the Act applies first to calendar year 2026.

instruments.title: Add Laki korkotulon lähdeverosta, 1341/1990
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki korkotulon lähdeverosta (1341/1990), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Withholding Tax on Interest Income

obligations.title: Add the duty: Withhold the 30 percent source tax on deposit interest

titles.en: Withhold the 30 percent source tax on deposit interest

summaries.en: A deposit bank, a Finnish branch of a foreign credit institution or another payer named in the Act must withhold the interest income source tax of 30 percent from each interest payment on a deposit or bond covered by the Act when it pays or credits the interest to the taxpayer, and is liable for the tax alongside the taxpayer.

instruments.title: Add Kyberturvallisuuslaki, 124/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Kyberturvallisuuslaki (124/2025), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Cybersecurity Act

payload.implementsNote: NIS2, Directive (EU) 2022/2555

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks to network and information systems

titles.en: Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks to network and information systems

summaries.en: An entity within the Act's scope must identify, assess and manage the risks to the security of the network and information systems it uses, with up-to-date, proportionate and adequate measures that prevent or minimise the impact of incidents. Under 5 §, where an EU regulation imposes at least equivalent cybersecurity risk-management or incident-reporting duties, those apply instead.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make management responsible for cybersecurity risk management

titles.en: Make management responsible for cybersecurity risk management

summaries.en: The entity's board, supervisory board and chief executive are responsible for organising and overseeing cybersecurity risk management, approve the risk management operating model and oversee its implementation, and must have sufficient knowledge of cybersecurity risk management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report significant incidents to the supervisor within 24 hours

titles.en: Report significant incidents to the supervisor within 24 hours
