summaries.en: The entity must notify its supervisory authority without delay of any significant incident, with an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware of it and a follow-up notification within 72 hours, an interim report on request or after a month for a prolonged incident, and a final report within a month of the follow-up notification.

instruments.title: Add Laki kryptovarapalvelun tarjoajista ja kryptovaramarkkinoista, 402/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kryptovarapalvelun tarjoajista ja kryptovaramarkkinoista (402/2024), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on Crypto-Asset Service Providers and Crypto-Asset Markets

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep crypto-asset service customers' information confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kryptovarapalvelun tarjoajista ja kryptovaramarkkinoista (402/2024), 6 §

titles.en: Keep crypto-asset service customers' information confidential

summaries.en: Anyone who, as an officer or employee of a crypto-asset service provider, its group company or a firm acting for it, learns information about a customer's financial position or personal circumstances or a business secret must keep it confidential unless the protected person consents or the law permits disclosure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain to FIN-FSA on request why disclosure of crypto inside information was delayed
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki kryptovarapalvelun tarjoajista ja kryptovaramarkkinoista (402/2024), 9 §

titles.en: Explain to FIN-FSA on request why disclosure of crypto inside information was delayed

summaries.en: An issuer, offeror or person seeking admission to trading must, when FIN-FSA asks, provide its explanation of how the conditions for delaying the disclosure of inside information under Article 88(3) MiCA were met.

instruments.title: Add Laki varojen jäädyttämisestä terrorismin torjumiseksi, 325/2013
instruments.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki varojen jäädyttämisestä terrorismin torjumiseksi (325/2013), consolidated text in force

titles.en: Act on the Freezing of Funds with a View to Combating Terrorism

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze funds of persons subject to a national freezing decision
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki varojen jäädyttämisestä terrorismin torjumiseksi (325/2013), 3 § ja 6 §

titles.en: Freeze funds of persons subject to a national freezing decision

summaries.en: Funds belonging to persons and entities subject to a freezing decision under the Act must be frozen, and frozen funds may not be moved, transferred, converted, used or dealt with in any way that would change their amount, location, ownership, possession, nature or purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds available to persons whose funds are frozen
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, Laki varojen jäädyttämisestä terrorismin torjumiseksi (325/2013), 7 §

titles.en: Make no funds available to persons whose funds are frozen

summaries.en: No one may directly or indirectly make funds available to a person or entity whose funds are frozen under the Act, unless an authority, credit institution or financial institution arranges it so that the funds are frozen; funds intended only for the personal use of a natural person and their family are exempt.

instruments.title: Add Rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estäminen, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023: Rahanpesun ja terrorismin rahoittamisen estäminen

titles.en: Prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document a reasoned AML risk assessment and review it every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023, luku 4.2 kohdat 7–15 ja luku 4.3 kohdat 23–27 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Document a reasoned AML risk assessment and review it every year

summaries.en: A supervised entity's risk assessment must set out its reasoned view of how its products and services could be used for money laundering and terrorist financing and identify and weigh the risk factors of its customers, countries, products, services, transactions, channels and technologies. It must check the assessment is up to date every year, document the check and update the assessment whenever the risk factors change, for example with new products, customer groups, regions or channels.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check that the person matches the photo on the identity document
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023, luku 6.3.2 kohta 37 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Check that the person matches the photo on the identity document

summaries.en: When verifying identity from an identity document, the supervised entity must make sure that the person resembles the person in the document's photograph in appearance, age and the other data in the document.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Resource ongoing monitoring and run automated transaction monitoring
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023, luku 7.1 kohdat 17–21 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Resource ongoing monitoring and run automated transaction monitoring

summaries.en: The supervised entity must allocate sufficient financial, technical and staff resources to ongoing monitoring so it can detect and react without undue delay to unusual transactions, and credit institutions and payment institutions must use IT-based transaction monitoring whose scenarios are based on the entity's risk assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give customers reasonable time and channels to supply due diligence information
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023, luku 8.2 kohdat 7–8 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Give customers reasonable time and channels to supply due diligence information

summaries.en: Before restricting or ending a customer relationship because due diligence cannot be completed, the supervised entity must give the customer enough time to provide the information and allow it to be provided through different means, bearing in mind that not all customers can use digital channels.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the annual AML risk data to FIN-FSA by 28 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 2/2023, luku 11 kohdat 5–6 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Submit the annual AML risk data to FIN-FSA by 28 February

summaries.en: The supervised entity must submit to FIN-FSA the information on its money laundering and terrorist financing risks and risk management under the current RA data collection framework every year by 28 February.

instruments.title: Add Pakotesääntelyn ja kansallisten jäädyttämispäätösten noudattamiseen liittyvä asiakkaan tunteminen, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023: Pakotesääntelyn ja kansallisten jäädyttämispäätösten noudattamiseen liittyvä asiakkaan tunteminen

titles.fi: Pakotesääntelyn ja kansallisten jäädyttämispäätösten noudattamiseen liittyvä asiakkaan tunteminen
titles.en: Customer due diligence relating to compliance with sanctions regulation and national freezing decisions

payload.shortName: Pakotesääntelyn ja kansallisten jäädyttämispäätösten noudattamiseen liittyvä asiakkaan tunteminen

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the firm's exposure to sanctions breaches and evasion every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023, luku 5 kohta 6 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Assess the firm's exposure to sanctions breaches and evasion every year

summaries.en: The supervised entity must prepare a risk assessment identifying the threats and vulnerabilities relating to breaches of sanctions and national freezing decisions and to sanctions evasion, and the likelihood of their occurring. It must check the assessment at least yearly, update it when needed and document the checks and updates with reasons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen customers and beneficial owners against sanctions lists and freeze their funds
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023, luku 7.2 kohdat 16–22 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Screen customers and beneficial owners against sanctions lists and freeze their funds

summaries.en: At onboarding the supervised entity must check the current EU and national sanctions lists to establish whether the customer or its beneficial owners are designated or more than 50 percent owned or controlled by designated parties, and freeze funds where required. It must re-screen the whole customer base without delay whenever the lists are updated and when a customer's name changes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen payments against sanctions lists before executing them
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023, luku 7.3 kohdat 32–35 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Screen payments against sanctions lists before executing them

summaries.en: Wherever technically possible, the supervised entity must check the current sanctions and national freezing lists before executing, transmitting or receiving payments, establish whether a designated party or an entity it owns or controls is involved, and freeze the funds and prevent funds being made available to them; instant credit transfers under the Instant Payments Regulation are excluded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep sanctions screening systems fit for purpose and test them regularly
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023, luku 7.6 kohdat 61–64 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Keep sanctions screening systems fit for purpose and test them regularly

summaries.en: The supervised entity must ensure its sanctions monitoring systems are fit for purpose and proportionate to its size and business, test them regularly and always after system changes, correct deficiencies without delay and develop the systems as needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit sanctions control data to FIN-FSA by 28 February each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2023, luku 11 kohdat 4–5 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Submit sanctions control data to FIN-FSA by 28 February each year

summaries.en: The supervised entity must submit to FIN-FSA, by 28 February each year, the information on its internal control and risk management means relating to sanctions under the current RA data collection framework.

instruments.title: Add Operatiivisen riskin hallinta rahoitussektorin valvottavissa, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014: Operatiivisen riskin hallinta rahoitussektorin valvottavissa

titles.en: Management of operational risk in supervised entities of the financial sector

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the board approve operational risk management policies and procedures
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014, luku 4.3 kohdat 6–7 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Have the board approve operational risk management policies and procedures

summaries.en: The supervised entity's board must approve operational risk management policies and procedures covering the methods and processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring and limiting the risk, and they must be reviewed periodically to reflect changes in the operating environment and the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify operational risks and assess new products before launch
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014, luku 4.4 kohdat 11–15 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Identify operational risks and assess new products before launch

summaries.en: The supervised entity must identify the operational risks in all its significant products, services, functions, processes and systems that could materially affect its objectives, and must assess the risks of a new product, service or service model before introducing it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain tested business continuity plans for key business functions
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014, luku 7.2 kohdat 5–10 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Maintain tested business continuity plans for key business functions

summaries.en: The board is responsible for ensuring that the supervised entity's key business functions have up-to-date and adequate continuity plans, and management must define responsibilities and a clear model for preparing, maintaining and testing the plans and for identifying and prioritising the most important business processes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the largest operational risk losses to FIN-FSA by 28 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 8/2014, luku 8.2.2 kohdat 8–12 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Report the largest operational risk losses to FIN-FSA by 28 February

summaries.en: The supervised entity must send FIN-FSA by 28 February an annual report on the operational risk losses detected in the previous year, covering the five largest loss events of the calendar year in euro terms.

instruments.title: Add Luottoriskien hallinta ja luottokelpoisuuden arviointi rahoitussektorin valvottavissa, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018: Luottoriskien hallinta ja luottokelpoisuuden arviointi rahoitussektorin valvottavissa

titles.fi: Luottoriskien hallinta ja luottokelpoisuuden arviointi rahoitussektorin valvottavissa
titles.en: Credit risk management and creditworthiness assessment in supervised entities of the financial sector

payload.shortName: Luottoriskien hallinta ja luottokelpoisuuden arviointi rahoitussektorin valvottavissa

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base every credit decision on a documented credit analysis
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018, luku 4.4.1 kohdat 20–29 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Base every credit decision on a documented credit analysis

summaries.en: A credit decision must be based on a credit analysis giving a sufficiently comprehensive view of the applicant, its creditworthiness and the financed project, using the listed information such as financial statements or income and expense data and credit register data whose accuracy is verified. The decision must consider at least repayment history and capacity, purpose, financing plan, collateral and the effect of changing economic conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Lend primarily on repayment capacity, not on collateral
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018, luku 4.4.2 kohdat 39–44 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Lend primarily on repayment capacity, not on collateral

summaries.en: A credit decision must be based primarily on the customer's creditworthiness; credit should generally not be granted if the customer can repay only by realising collateral, and in exceptional structures relying on collateral the entity must monitor the collateral's value and ensure repayment is secured.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Decide credits under a written lending policy and a documented process
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018, luku 4.4.3 kohdat 47–64 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Decide credits under a written lending policy and a documented process

summaries.en: Credit decisions must follow written lending instructions approved by executive management, and the handling of each credit from application to decision must be documented and approved at the correct decision-making level.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Diversify lending and set concentration limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 4/2018, luku 4.6 kohdat 77–79 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Diversify lending and set concentration limits

summaries.en: Senior management must ensure lending and other credit-risk activity is sufficiently diversified, define the significant exposures and exposure groups that need limits, and set limits at least by product, counterparty, industry and country or country group, monitoring their use.

instruments.title: Add Ulkoistaminen rahoitussektoriin kuuluvissa valvottavissa, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2012
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2012: Ulkoistaminen rahoitussektoriin kuuluvissa valvottavissa

titles.en: Outsourcing in supervised entities of the financial sector

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the prescribed details when notifying FIN-FSA of outsourcing a significant function
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2012, luku 8.3.1 kohdat 9–10 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Include the prescribed details when notifying FIN-FSA of outsourcing a significant function

summaries.en: A notification to FIN-FSA of outsourcing a significant function must include the service provider's identity and address, a description of the nature and scope of the outsourced activity, an overall assessment of its impact, the provider's financial capacity, how internal control, risk management, continuity and information security are ensured, and the other items listed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check an outsourcing provider's resources, competence and controls before relying on it
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2012, luku 4.4 kohdat 21–22 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Check an outsourcing provider's resources, competence and controls before relying on it

summaries.en: A payment institution must ensure that the provider of an outsourced activity has adequate resources, skills, financial capacity, expertise and any licences required, and has organised adequate internal control and risk management, and must have procedures to assess the provider's performance.

instruments.title: Add Pankkipalveluissa noudatettavat menettelytavat, Määräykset ja ohjeet 3/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 3/2024: Pankkipalveluissa noudatettavat menettelytavat

titles.en: Conduct of business in banking services

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use FIN-FSA's representative example for the APR in housing credit advertising
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 3/2024, luku 5 kohdat 7–11 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Use FIN-FSA's representative example for the APR in housing credit advertising

summaries.en: When housing credit advertising must state the annual percentage rate, it must be given through a representative example calculated on FIN-FSA's assumptions, including a 100 000 euro credit repaid over 20 years in equal monthly instalments, the most common interest rate fixation and the calculated margin from Bank of Finland statistics, unless the creditor's own loans differ significantly. The assumptions used must be stated clearly next to the calculation.

instruments.title: Add Maksukyvyttömyysriskien hallinta kuluttajaluotonannossa, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2025: Maksukyvyttömyysriskien hallinta kuluttajaluotonannossa

titles.en: Management of insolvency risks in consumer lending

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure the risk rating model's reliability with a Gini coefficient
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2025, luku 4.2 kohdat 3–4 ja 8 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Measure the risk rating model's reliability with a Gini coefficient

summaries.en: The supervised entity must measure how reliably its risk rating model assesses insolvency risk at the time of lending with a Gini coefficient, calculated with FIN-FSA's method as at 31 December over the loans granted in the preceding one-to-two-year period.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Track the share of bad loans in the riskiest five percent of new lending
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2025, luku 4.4 kohdat 16–17 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Track the share of bad loans in the riskiest five percent of new lending

summaries.en: The supervised entity must use as its measure of reasonable insolvency risk the share of bad loans among all loans in the highest-risk five percent class of its risk rating system, calculated with FIN-FSA's method.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report unsecured consumer credit risk data to FIN-FSA on the MK form
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2025, luku 4.5 kohdat 26–38 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Report unsecured consumer credit risk data to FIN-FSA on the MK form

summaries.en: The supervised entity, at consolidated level where it is a group parent, must report its unsecured consumer credits under chapter 7 of the Consumer Protection Act to FIN-FSA yearly on the MK form, split into twenty equal risk classes with the prescribed data.

instruments.title: Add Sijoituspalvelujen toiminnan järjestäminen ja menettelytavat, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018
instruments.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, määräys- ja ohjekokoelma, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018: Sijoituspalvelujen toiminnan järjestäminen ja menettelytavat

titles.en: Organisation and conduct of business in investment services

obligations.title: Add the duty: Operate product governance as a distributor of financial instruments
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018, luku 4.3 kohdat 21–32 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Operate product governance as a distributor of financial instruments

summaries.en: A firm offering or recommending financial instruments must have product governance arrangements that ensure the instruments and services are compatible with the needs, characteristics and objectives, including sustainability objectives, of the identified target market and that the distribution strategy fits it. It must obtain sufficient information from manufacturers and define a target market even where the manufacturer has not.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep records and reconciliations that protect client assets
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018, luku 5.2 kohdat 3–7 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Keep records and reconciliations that protect client assets

summaries.en: A firm holding client assets must keep records and accounts that let it distinguish each client's assets from other clients' and its own at any time, keep them accurate, reconcile them regularly with third-party custodians' records, ensure client instruments are held in separate accounts and client funds in segregated accounts, and minimise the risk of loss.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept inducements only against an additional or higher-quality service
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018, luku 6.3 kohdat 10–16 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Accept inducements only against an additional or higher-quality service

summaries.en: An inducement received in connection with services other than portfolio management or independent advice is justified only if it is matched by an additional or higher-level service to the client, such as non-independent advice on a broad range of instruments with an annual suitability review, or access to a wide range of instruments at competitive prices with value-adding tools or regular performance and cost information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure staff giving investment advice have the required knowledge and competence
obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 7/2018, luku 7.2.2 kohta 7 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Ensure staff giving investment advice have the required knowledge and competence

summaries.en: The firm must ensure that natural persons giving investment advice on its behalf have sufficient knowledge and competence, including understanding the main features, risks and costs of the instruments offered or recommended and the general tax consequences for the client.

obligations.sourceLabel: Finanssivalvonta, Määräykset ja ohjeet 1/2014, luku 4.2 kohdat 4–15 (binding regulation)

titles.en: Report loan-to-collateral data on new housing loans to FIN-FSA quarterly

summaries.en: A credit institution must report to FIN-FSA on the LTC form the loan-to-collateral data of consumer credits for buying or renovating homes in Finland granted and not yet reported, calculated at the time of granting under FIN-FSA regulation 3/2015, for the quarter-ends 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December and within 30 banking days of each.
